purpose: Determine whether BIEN 4.2 contains enough taxonomically resolved and geographically repeated observation-level trait support for prospective family-by-trait time/space turnover systems before any trait values are inspected.

primary_clade_definition.reason: Family is frozen as the primary repeated clade unit before outcomes because it is source-native, stable enough for BIEN-to-megatree crosswalk, and avoids outcome-informed slicing of the plant phylogeny.

record_identity.duplicate_rule: multiple physical rows with the same id count once

spatial_cell_rule.coordinate_rule: latitude and longitude non-null and within physical bounds; support counting does not infer or repair missing coordinates

eligibility.system_pass: family x trait passes only when both temporal and spatial requirements pass

source_viability_gate.reason: The prospective trait stratum requires replication across independent clades and more than one trait definition before outcome opening.

allowed_operations: aggregate support counting using only support_query_fields_allowed
PostGIS 25-km cell assignment from coordinates inside an aggregate query
forbidden_operations: selecting or returning unit or method
selecting or returning source_citation or url_source
choosing traits or families by any biological outcome
gate_order: verify live database is exactly BIEN 4.2
verify required schema and PostGIS availability
run aggregate family x trait support counts
next_gate_if_pass: Freeze eligible trait representations (continuous/categorical), taxonomic/phylogeny crosswalk and observed-geometry informativeness simulations using only passing family x trait systems before opening trait values.
next_gate_if_hold: Do not relax thresholds. Proceed to the already-frozen second trait source, AusTraits, only because the finite-family rule allows a pre-outcome support/schema/access switch.
